recent_en: LCTITAN had a winding up / receiver & manager / restraining order / special administrator announcement in September 2026 and disclosed material litigation. There were several OTHERS announcements in August and September 2026, and a quarterly report was released in November 2026.
notable_en: The company issued a winding up / receiver & manager / restraining order / special administrator announcement on 29 September 2026.
The company disclosed material litigation on 28 September 2026.
The company released its quarterly report for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 5 November 2026.
risks_en: The company made an announcement related to winding up / receiver & manager / restraining order / special administrator.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 3,107,694,000 and net loss was MYR 174,185,000, with a net margin of -5.6%; revenue grew 22.9% QoQ and 108.4% YoY, while net margin declined from -4.9% in the previous quarter.
